intent: Independently review the uncommitted guide work rail change in components/guide-pages.tsx, components/portfolio-teaser.tsx, and components/home-portfolio-rail.tsx. Check that it reuses only published portfolio work, preserves all existing homepage behavior, uses separate analytics attribution, is visually appropriate after a guide at phone and desktop widths, and introduces no misleading claim or accessibility regression. Return a concise verdict with concrete defects only.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: Production guide pages use a static proof card while the approved homepage has an interactive rail of published work.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: After reading a guide, show Esteban's beautiful homepage work carousel so the visitor can see that he does it well.
visual_evidence.comparison: Production guide proof card versus local 390x844 and 1440x900 guide rail.

brief.visitor: A Spanish-first guide reader evaluating a video or content project.
brief.promise: After the practical answer, see finished, approved work before choosing the next step.
brief.primary_action: Open a published project from the rail or continue to the existing scoped inquiry.
brief.friction: A static single-project proof card does not let a buyer judge a wider body of work.

kpi.event: guide_work rail interaction followed by contact intent
kpi.denominator: guide readers who reach the shelf
kpi.evidence: The existing delegated rail/CTA event pipeline will distinguish guide_work from home_portfolio.
kpi.decision_rule: retain if behavior is attributable and the interface remains usable.

concept.idea: Reuse the approved homepage portfolio rail beneath the article.
concept.brand_reason: The page demonstrates real finished work rather than adding decorative guide imagery.
concept.interaction: Swipe, keyboard controls, open project or play an eligible reel in place.
concept.visible_response: Published posters and normal links are present at first render.
concept.direct_path: A published portfolio route or the existing guide contact path.
concept.alternatives: No invented work, new stock art, autoplay dependency, or separate carousel implementation.

story.next_step: Open a project or start a scoped conversation.

content.visible: Existing work-first heading, catalog description, approved portfolio cards and controls.
content.optional_html: No critical content is hidden or client-mounted.
content.linked_depth: Published portfolio and existing guide support links.

references.avoid: A duplicate custom carousel or unsupported proof.

components.local_reason: Only the analytics source prop changes to make guide attribution honest.

verification.rendered_states: 390x844 and 1440x900 after a representative Spanish guide.
verification.accessibility_performance: Existing links, labeled controls and lazy images remain from the shared shelf.
verification.raw_html: The work heading and portfolio links are present in generated guide HTML.

learning.metric: guide_work rail interaction followed by inquiry
learning.hypothesis: Showing real work after a guide reduces evaluation uncertainty.
learning.decision_rule: retain only with usable rendered proof and attributable behavior
